title: These rice paper burger pops have 75g of protein! 😎
description:
⇩ Full Recipe 🍔 ⇩

Macros per serving:

Protein: 75g
Carbs: 58g
Fat: 18g
Calories: 715

Ingredients per serving (makes 1 servings):

- 7 oz 97% lean ground beef, raw
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 tbsp minced garlic
- 2 tsp onion powder
- 3 sheets rice paper
- 2 eggs (whisked)
- 1/4 red onion
- 6 green leaf lettuce leaves
- 3 tsp low-fat mozzarella cheese

Dipping Sauce:

- 1/2 cup 0% fat greek yogurt
- 3 tbsp ketchup
- 2 tsp worcestershire sauce
- 2 tsp pickle juice
- 1 tbsp dijon mustard
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder

How to make it yourself:

1. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.
2. Finely dice your red onions.
3. In a bowl mix together lean ground beef, salt, black pepper, minced garlic, red onions, and onion powder.
4. Whisk your two eggs in a small bowl.
5. Dip your rice paper into the whisked eggs.
6. On a piece of parchment paper coated with a spray of oil, place your wet rice paper and on top and place a third of your ground beef, two green leaf lettuce leaves, and a third of your mozzarella cheese. Your filling should be placed in a long line from the top of the rice paper to the bottom, and fold over the rice paper encasing the filling and creating a long, thin log/burrito shape. Repeat this step two more times.
7. Cut the rice paper logs into 1 inch pieces with scissors. 
8. Spray your pops with spray oil and place in the oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until fully cooked through and crispy golden brown.
9. In a bowl mix together greek yogurt, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, pickle juice, dijon mustard, garlic powder, and onion powder to make your dipping sauce and enjoy!

📩 Save this rice paper burger pop recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! I’d love to see how you liked the recipe! :)
